title: Zesty Split Irish Peas Stew
description: Hearty, comforting stew made with split peas, Irish bacon, and crunchy vegetables, finished with a tangy mantecare emulsion.
instructions: Heat butter in a large cazuela over medium heat.
Add chopped onion, carrot, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add diced Irish bacon and cook until crispy.
Add split peas, milk, and flour, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add chopped scallions and mint leaves, and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the stew to a serving dish and serve hot.
Meanwhile, prepare the mantecare emulsion by whisking together milk and flour in a small saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Strain the emulsion into a bowl and whisk in butter until melted and smooth.
Serve the stew hot, topped with a dollop of mantecare emulsion.
